why_not_core_ontology_concept: Storage structure does not establish domain identity conditions
correct_treatment: RDB projection artifact; map to ontology concepts under #45/#46

why_not_core_ontology_concept: A field may encode attribute, relation, role, result, status or UI convenience
correct_treatment: Field-to-semantic mapping with provenance; never one-column-one-class

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Controlled vocabulary value may be method/profile/data rather than universal class
correct_treatment: Keep method/profile/data value set unless identity criteria justify ontology class

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Presentation artifact, not domain entity
correct_treatment: Product/UI artifact only

why_not_core_ontology_concept: UI grouping has no automatic semantic unity
correct_treatment: Ignore for Core; preserve UX mapping only if needed

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Serialization/presentation unit, often corresponds to Risk Register Entry but not automatically Risk
correct_treatment: Map to information artifact if governed identity exists

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Product/workflow record, not necessarily Governance Issue or Risk
correct_treatment: Model as information artifact/workflow record; link to domain issue/risk if applicable

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Record of incident, not the incident occurrence itself
correct_treatment: Separate Incident occurrence from Incident Record

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Workflow state values do not prove real-world risk state
correct_treatment: Workflow State vocabulary only

artifact_or_conflation: Inherent Risk as separate timeless Risk class
why_not_core_ontology_concept: Usually denotes assessment context/result rather than distinct enduring identity
correct_treatment: Inherent Risk Assessment Result unless W2 evidence overturns

artifact_or_conflation: Residual Risk as separate timeless Risk class
why_not_core_ontology_concept: Usually denotes post-treatment assessment context/result rather than distinct enduring identity
correct_treatment: Residual Risk Assessment Result unless W2 evidence overturns

why_not_core_ontology_concept: A numeric/ordinal assessment output is not the phenomenon being assessed
correct_treatment: Risk Assessment Result

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Source taxonomies vary and are classification schemes
correct_treatment: Profile/mapping vocabulary; require identity criteria before subclassing

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Owner is a role/responsibility, not an organization kind
correct_treatment: Role borne by external actor

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Sources mix strategy, plan, activity, policy, mechanism and system behavior
correct_treatment: Use separated treatment/control pattern

why_not_core_ontology_concept: A URL alone does not represent derivation/version/agent/time history
correct_treatment: Provenance pattern with source identity/version/derivation

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Association evidence cannot justify causal ontology assertion
correct_treatment: Association Relation unless causal evidence is explicit

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Synthetic fixtures test executability/regression, not real-world validity
correct_treatment: Regression/illustrative evidence only

artifact_or_conflation: Ontology parse/reasoner PASS as semantic validity
why_not_core_ontology_concept: Logical consistency is only one verification dimension
correct_treatment: Verification evidence; not full validation/assurance

why_not_core_ontology_concept: Mutable refs are not reproducible release identifiers
correct_treatment: Use immutable commit/release/version IRI

artifact_or_conflation: Pharma entities copied into SemRisk Core
why_not_core_ontology_concept: External semantic owner already exists in CM-PharmE
correct_treatment: Federate/map to CM-PharmE

artifact_or_conflation: Risk Register as set of risk phenomena
why_not_core_ontology_concept: Register is information-management repository
correct_treatment: Risk Register contains Risk Register Entries that refer to risk-related entities
